models._help: Each role is a chain 'provider:model': the first answers; when it has no balance, a bad key, a limit, or is down, the next one answers instantly. Order: Anthropic (Claude) -> Groq -> OpenRouter -> Cloudflare. Vision (reading uploaded PDFs/images) is separate: Gemini first. Keys: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY (free models only unless allow_paid_openrouter_models), CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN + CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, GEMINI_API_KEY. Override a chain for testing in .env, e.g. HQ_MODEL_AGENT=groq:openai/gpt-oss-120b

_rate_limits_help: Tokens-per-minute limit per model, read from Groq's x-ratelimit headers for this account (Groq free tier: 8,000/min, 1,000 requests/day; gpt-oss also 200,000 tokens/day). OpenRouter free models: ~20 requests/min and 50/day on a key without credits. The app waits for per-minute limits and falls back along the chain for daily limits or outages.

chat._help: max_message_chars: longest message a user can send. recent_exchanges_verbatim: how many recent user/assistant exchanges the agent sees word-for-word; older ones are folded into a running summary (nothing is lost: facts and quotes also live in long-term memory).

uploads._help: Per message: max_images images + max_pdfs PDFs, each up to max_file_mb; PDFs up to max_pdf_pages pages. Files are read by background Celery workers (redis_url); if no worker is running the app reads them in a background thread instead. render_dpi / max_image_side_px control how sharp PDF pages are for the vision model.
